def glyphs(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join('B' if a[44][21+5*i]=='B' else 'w' for i in range(5))
def bar(f): return f.ascii.split('\n')[1].count('b')
def piece(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and 5<n['pixels']<20:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(rows)<20: return (min(rows),max(rows))
    return None
print("start bar:", bar(current_frame), "piece row:", piece(current_frame))
# wait/observe: click harmless board spot a few times, watch piece & bar
for i in range(5):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':30}])
    print("after",i+1,"bar:", bar(current_frame), "piece row:", piece(current_frame), "glyphs:", glyphs(current_frame), "done:", last_action_result.get('done'), "over:", last_action_result.get('game_over'))
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('done'): break
</parameter>
